decisions.option: B (the returning-visitor row only). Option A ('What you get / what you need' block) skipped: it waits for approved copy.
decisions.what_changed: The welcome screen gets one row under Start when this browser holds an adult consent record (of any terms version) and earlier data: a secondary button 'See my results' (the ready screen's own label and UX-010 path: the earlier results with no new session) and, when notes settings are kept, a link 'Notes for your AI (opens in a new tab)' to notes.html. The row is a role=group named 'Earlier results and notes on this device'. A first visit sees nothing new; Start is still the only primary button. Reads: with no adult record the page reads exactly one key (the consent record, which Start already read); only with a record are the autosaves read (restoreAutosaves, about 1 ms), nothing is written, nothing is scored (the quick look is 'some session holds an answer'; buildResults takes 120 to 300 ms and runs when the button is pressed). 'See my results' goes straight to the results when readConsent honours the record (current terms), and through the 18+ gate first when it does not; after the gate it records the consent, restores the saves and shows the results, never the honour code or the device check. If the saves hold nothing scorable at that point (all answers on skipped skills, or saves changed in another tab) it goes the usual way in (honour code) instead of to an empty page. A focus session asked for from results opened this way needs a device record and the honour code, which that path never had: startFocus (it used to return silently when device was null) now sends the person through the honour code and the device check first and starts the part afterwards (pendingFocus). With a server (backend) the results button is not offered (the ready screen does not offer it either, R-11.1); the notes link is. Autosaves of several identifiers (the person chooses on the ready screen) give no results button. 'Back to the start' reads the row again. CHOICE ON OLDER RECORDS (made by this package within the provisional default, open to the owner): an adult record of ANY terms version (new gate.ts hasAdultRecord: v 1, adult true, terms a string) may reveal the row. Reason: it proves that the 18+ gate was passed in this browser, and the row is only a door; it is not consent for the current terms, so readConsent (which lets the flow skip the gate) is unchanged and 'See my results' with such a record shows the new gate first, before any autosave is read or written. Under-18 path: it reads the consent key and nothing else, writes nothing (tests assert the exact storage calls). The static first-paint shell (index.html) is untouched.

decisions.option: B (start the refresh-rate measurement while the gate is shown). A (merging gate and honour screen) not chosen.
decisions.what_changed: The flow starts the existing measurement (measureRefreshRate on rAF frames, the real clock, the 4 s give-up, the same estimate) as a RefreshProbe when Start leads to the gate, or to the honour screen where the gate is skipped, and hands it to the device check. Done when the device screen opens: its facts are in at once (no 'Checking your screen', Continue enabled, no frames asked for again). Still under way: the screen waits for what is left of it, once. Hidden at the start: no probe (null); hidden while measuring: the probe cancels its pending frame and ends with null; cancelled, too old (more than 2 minutes: the window may have moved to another screen) or without a rate: the screen measures itself, as before. The device record is built by the new describeDevice from the probe's rate, the timer resolution and the window as they are when the screen opens, so the DeviceInfo is the same as today (checkDevice is describeDevice after measureHz; field-for-field equality is tested). In memory only: nothing is stored or read; the under-18 choice cancels it (no more frames), 'I chose this by mistake' starts it again, restart and unmount cancel it. 'See my results' with no session coming starts none. No change to timing code: rAF and performance.now only.
